#### Manual Testing Checklist

Before shipping, manually test these scenarios:

✅ **Basic Conversation:**
- [ ] Send simple text message
- [ ] Receive coherent response
- [ ] Conversation history updates

✅ **Tool Calling:**
- [ ] Agent decides to use tool correctly
- [ ] Tool executes successfully
- [ ] Natural language response after tool
- [ ] Multiple tools in sequence
- [ ] Tool with no parameters
- [ ] Tool with optional parameters
- [ ] Tool with all parameters

✅ **Error Handling:**
- [ ] Backend API down
- [ ] Network error
- [ ] Tool execution failure
- [ ] Invalid tool arguments
- [ ] Rate limit hit
- [ ] Timeout

✅ **Edge Cases:**
- [ ] Very long conversation (50+ turns)
- [ ] Rapid successive messages
- [ ] Messages with special characters
- [ ] Image support (if applicable)
- [ ] Empty message
- [ ] Message while previous processing

✅ **State Management:**
- [ ] `getHistory()` returns correct history
- [ ] `clearHistory()` resets conversation
- [ ] `setModel()` updates model
- [ ] Update callbacks trigger correctly
- [ ] Multiple agent instances don't interfere

✅ **Performance:**
- [ ] Response time acceptable (< 5s for simple queries)
- [ ] Memory usage stable over long conversations
- [ ] No memory leaks on instance cleanup

#### Testing Best Practices

**1. Mock External Dependencies**

Always mock:
- `fetch()` calls
- Callbacks (`onToolCall`, `onUpdate`)
- `localStorage` (if used)

**2. Test Edge Cases**

Don't just test happy path:
- Empty strings
- Very long strings
- Special characters
- Null/undefined
- Unexpected response formats

**3. Use Descriptive Test Names**

```typescript
// ❌ Bad
it('works', () => { /* ... */ });

// ✅ Good
it('executes tool calls and returns natural language response', () => { /* ... */ });
```

**4. Isolate Tests**

Each test should:
- Create fresh agent instance
- Mock fresh dependencies
- Clean up after itself

**5. Test Error Messages**

Verify user-friendly error messages:
```typescript
it('shows user-friendly error for network failure', async () => {
  (global.fetch as vi.Mock).mockRejectedValueOnce(new Error('Network error'));

  await agent.chat('test');

  const history = agent.getHistory();
  const lastMessage = history[history.length - 1];
  expect(lastMessage.content).toContain('Network error');
  expect(lastMessage.content).not.toContain('fetch'); // No technical jargon
});
```

### 8.7. Common Pitfalls

Avoid these common mistakes when creating agents.

#### Pitfall 1: Forgetting `credentials: 'include'`

**Problem:**
```typescript
const response = await fetch('/api/ai/chat', {
  method: 'POST',
  // ❌ Missing credentials!
  body: JSON.stringify({ /* ... */ }),
});
```

**Impact:** Backend can't identify user, requests fail with 401.

**Solution:**
```typescript
const response = await fetch('/api/ai/chat', {
  method: 'POST',
  credentials: 'include',  // ✅ Include auth cookies
  body: JSON.stringify({ /* ... */ }),
});
```

#### Pitfall 2: Mutating Display History Directly

**Problem:**
```typescript
getHistory(): ChatMessage[] {
  return this._displayHistory;  // ❌ Returns reference!
}
```

**Impact:** Consumers can mutate internal state:
```typescript
const history = agent.getHistory();
history.push({ /* fake message */ });  // Mutates agent state!
```

**Solution:**
```typescript
getHistory(): ChatMessage[] {
  return [...this._displayHistory];  // ✅ Return copy
}
```

#### Pitfall 3: Not Handling Tool Execution Errors

**Problem:**
```typescript
const result = await this._onToolCall(toolName, toolArgs);
// ❌ No try-catch - errors crash conversation
this._history.push({ role: 'tool', content: JSON.stringify(result) });
```

**Impact:** Single tool failure breaks entire conversation.

**Solution:**
```typescript
try {
  const result = await this._onToolCall(toolName, toolArgs);
  this._history.push({
    role: 'tool',
    tool_call_id: toolCall.id,
    name: toolName,
    content: JSON.stringify(result),
  } as any);
} catch (error) {
  // ✅ Graceful error handling
  this._history.push({
    role: 'tool',
    tool_call_id: toolCall.id,
    name: toolName,
    content: JSON.stringify({
      success: false,
      error: error.message,
    }),
  } as any);
}
```

#### Pitfall 4: Not Removing Thinking Indicators

**Problem:**
```typescript
// Add thinking indicator
this._displayHistory.push({
  role: 'assistant',
  content: '🤔 Working on it...',
});
this.notifyUpdate();

// Execute tools...

// ❌ Forgot to remove thinking indicator!
// Final response added, but thinking message remains
```

**Impact:** UI shows "Working on it..." permanently.

**Solution:**
```typescript
// Remove thinking indicators before adding final response
this._displayHistory = this._displayHistory.filter(
  (msg) => !msg.content.startsWith('🤔')
);
```

#### Pitfall 5: Forgetting Second API Call After Tools

**Problem:**
```typescript
if (assistantMessage.tool_calls?.length > 0) {
  // Execute tools...
  for (const toolCall of assistantMessage.tool_calls) {
    await this.executeToolCall(toolCall);
  }

  // ❌ No second API call - no natural language response!
  this._displayHistory.push({
    role: 'assistant',
    content: 'Done!',  // Generic, unhelpful
  });
}
```

**Impact:** User sees "Done!" instead of meaningful explanation.

**Solution:**
```typescript
if (assistantMessage.tool_calls?.length > 0) {
  // Execute tools...

  // ✅ Second API call for natural language summary
  const finalResponse = await this.callBackendChat(this._history);
  const finalMessage = finalResponse.choices[0].message;

  this._displayHistory.push({
    role: 'assistant',
    content: finalMessage.content || 'Done!',
  });
}
```

#### Pitfall 6: Unbounded History Growth

**Problem:**
```typescript
// ❌ No history pruning - memory grows unbounded
async chat(userMessage: string): Promise<void> {
  this._history.push({ role: 'user', content: userMessage });
  // ...
}
```

**Impact:** Long conversations consume excessive memory and slow down API calls.

**Solution:**
```typescript
async chat(userMessage: string): Promise<void> {
  this._history.push({ role: 'user', content: userMessage });

  // ✅ Prune history periodically
  this.pruneHistory(50);  // Keep system prompt + 49 recent messages

  // ...
}

private pruneHistory(maxMessages: number): void {
  if (this._history.length > maxMessages) {
    const systemPrompt = this._history[0];
    const recentMessages = this._history.slice(-maxMessages + 1);
    this._history = [systemPrompt, ...recentMessages];
  }
}
```

#### Pitfall 7: Exposing API Keys in Frontend

**Problem:**
```typescript
// ❌ NEVER DO THIS
const response = await fetch('https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions', {
  headers: {
    'Authorization': `Bearer ${process.env.OPENROUTER_API_KEY}`,  // Exposed!
  },
});
```

**Impact:** API keys visible in browser, can be stolen and abused.

**Solution:**
```typescript
// ✅ Always use backend proxy
const response = await fetch('/api/ai/chat', {
  credentials: 'include',  // Backend resolves keys securely
});
```

#### Pitfall 8: Poor Error Messages

**Problem:**
```typescript
catch (error) {
  this._displayHistory.push({
    role: 'assistant',
    content: `Error: ${error.stack}`,  // ❌ Technical stack trace
  });
}
```

**Impact:** Users see confusing technical errors.

**Solution:**
```typescript
catch (error) {
  console.error('[YourAgent] Error:', error);  // Log for debugging

  // ✅ User-friendly error message
  let userMessage = 'Sorry, something went wrong.';

  if (error.message.includes('fetch')) {
    userMessage = 'Network error - please check your connection.';
  } else if (error.message.includes('401')) {
    userMessage = 'Please log in to continue.';
  } else if (error.message.includes('429')) {
    userMessage = 'Too many requests - please wait a moment.';
  }

  this._displayHistory.push({
    role: 'assistant',
    content: userMessage,
  });
}
```

#### Pitfall 9: Not Validating Tool Arguments

**Problem:**
```typescript
const toolArgs = JSON.parse(toolCall.function.arguments);
// ❌ No validation - invalid args crash tool execution
await this._onToolCall(toolName, toolArgs);
```

**Impact:** Malformed arguments cause tool failures.

**Solution:**
```typescript
const toolArgs = JSON.parse(toolCall.function.arguments);

// ✅ Validate required parameters
if (toolName === 'generate_background' && !toolArgs.prompt) {
  throw new Error('Missing required parameter: prompt');
}

await this._onToolCall(toolName, toolArgs);
```

#### Pitfall 10: Inconsistent Update Notifications

**Problem:**
```typescript
async chat(userMessage: string): Promise<void> {
  this._displayHistory.push({ role: 'user', content: userMessage });
  // ❌ Forgot to call notifyUpdate()

  const response = await this.callBackendChat(this._history);
  this._displayHistory.push({ role: 'assistant', content: response.content });
  this.notifyUpdate();  // Only called once
}
```

**Impact:** UI doesn't update when user message added, appears frozen.

**Solution:**
```typescript
async chat(userMessage: string): Promise<void> {
  this._displayHistory.push({ role: 'user', content: userMessage });
  this.notifyUpdate();  // ✅ Update immediately

  const response = await this.callBackendChat(this._history);
  this._displayHistory.push({ role: 'assistant', content: response.content });
  this.notifyUpdate();  // ✅ Update again
}
```

**General Rule:** Call `notifyUpdate()` after EVERY change to `_displayHistory`.

#### Pitfall Checklist

Before shipping your agent, verify:

✅ **Authentication:**
- [ ] Uses `credentials: 'include'`
- [ ] Never exposes API keys in frontend
- [ ] Handles 401 errors gracefully

✅ **State Management:**
- [ ] Returns copies, not references
- [ ] Prunes history to prevent unbounded growth
- [ ] Notifies updates consistently

✅ **Tool Calling:**
- [ ] Handles tool execution errors
- [ ] Makes second API call after tools
- [ ] Removes thinking indicators
- [ ] Validates tool arguments

✅ **Error Handling:**
- [ ] User-friendly error messages
- [ ] Logs technical details for debugging
- [ ] Graceful degradation
- [ ] Network errors handled

✅ **Testing:**
- [ ] Unit tests for core methods
- [ ] Integration tests for tool flow
- [ ] Manual testing completed
- [ ] Edge cases covered
